name: Watase Nagisa
source:
The eldest of her siblings, a truly beautiful girl with a lovely appearance and a kind heart.

She has a gentle personality, and rarely get angry. At home, she is the primary caretaker. She can be devious at times, and make her sister do the chores instead.

Having lost her father at a young age, and living with her mother and sister, she cherishes her family, and pamper her new brother as well.
